svg.text: Gasket groove in rim: 1.8 wide x 1.2 deep.
4x corner boss D8 with M3 insert hole D4.2 x 8 deep.
4x board standoff D6, 14.5 high, pilot hole D2.2 x 6 deep.
6x angled louver, 16 long, 45 deg, pitch 4.4 (see sheet 4).
Rear feet: 4x D10 x 3 high at (+/-40, +/-24).
Print: feet down, open side up, no supports.
General tolerance +/-0.2 mm (FDM). Dimensions in mm.
